linear-closed-form-v1.description: Internal tests against closed-form linear solutions in SI. Fixed before evaluation (guide §12). Not a commercial-compatibility tolerance.

mesh-convergence-v1.description: A discretized result against the exact solution at a stated mesh: not rounding, but the error of that mesh. Fixed before evaluation. Equilibrium stays exact.

drilling-penalty-v1.description: Exact for the element except for the small stiffening of its drilling term, decision 0019. A locked membrane misses this by tens of percent.

linear-closed-form-area-v1.description: As linear-closed-form-v1, for results an area element reproduces exactly, including its section forces. Its matrices lose some digits in scaling, hence the wider tolerance.

modes-closed-form-v1.description: Modes and spectra against closed forms. Tighter than the iteration needs: its convergence is 1e-11 on eigenvalues.

modes-mesh-v1.description: A lumped-mass period against the continuous beam at a stated mesh: the error of that mesh.
